With more patients dying, Edwards offers to share a procedure he learned in France, but is rebuffed by Thackery and Gallinger. Robertson addresses a typhoid-fever outbreak, Elkins is taken into Thackery's confidence and Sister Harriet breaks a taboo. Edwards finds an alternative way to perform his duties.

3.o: Thackery weighs performing surgery on a former flame, and orders Gallinger and Chickering to experiment on pigs.  Barrow goes the extra yard to square a debt. 5.o: Barrow can alleviate a debt if he treats one of Collier's wounded men and also urges Capt. Robertson to buy one of Thomas Edison's new inventions. 4.o: يتسلل "بيتر" و"روز" إلى حفلة في منزل السفير الإيراني، الأمر الذي يثير شكوك رئيس الفريق الأمني "جواد". أما "توماس" و"ماركوس"، فيتنافسان على خطة برنامج أبحاث "فوكسغلوف".

5.o: طمعًا في الحصول على معلومات حول قسم "نايت أكشن"، يُقدّم "جايكوب" عرضًا مُجزيًا لـ"سولومون"، فيما يشعر "جواد" بوجود خائن بينهم ويتولى "سامي" تنفيذ مهمة سرية في إيران.

6.o: تمرّ "روز" بحالة من تأنيب الضمير تُدخلها في صراع داخلي ويكشف "فيكتور" عن حقيقة ما يضمره لـ"توماس"، فيما ينقلب حال الصياد إلى فريسة مُطاردَة مع ملاحقة فريق "سولومون" لـ"بيتر".

7.o: يبدأ "بيتر" بالتعامل بقسوة مع "سولومون" لإجباره على الكلام. وتنطلق "روز"، بعد عثورها على دليل، للبحث عن إجابات من عالِم مختصّ في برنامج أبحاث "فوكسغلوف"... فتجد نفسها في موقف خطير.

8.o: في محاولة يائسة لمعرفة مكان "روز"، يبرم "بيتر" صفقة تغير قواعد اللعبة مع "جايكوب"، فيما يكتشف "توماس" المدى الذي قد يصل له "ماركوس" في سبيل خدمة والده.

9.o: تضع مهمة اختراق أحد أكثر المواقع أمانًا في نيويورك مهارات "بيتر" على المحك، وتحوك "روز" والدكتور "كول" خطة جريئة لإيقاف "ماركوس".

10.o: حين يكاد الوقت ينفد، يُسارع "بيتر" و"روز" لمنع وقوع إصابات جماعية، فيما تطرح "كاثرين" اقتراحًا مثيرًا للاهتمام.

4.o: يزور "بيتر" كوخ صيد فخم، فيتحول الأمر إلى صراع من أجل البقاء، فيما تزداد مخاوف "تشيلسي" حين يصدر "البيت الأبيض" بيانًا لا ينسجم مع المعطيات.

5.o: يسابق "بيتر" و"آدم" الزمن ويشرعان في مهمة خطيرة يتسللان خلالها إلى كازينو، ويعثر "جاي" على أدلة مخبأة في محفظة عملات مشفرة تقوده إلى تفاصيل الهجمة الإرهابية التالية.

6.o: تثير تحقيقات "تشيلسي" السرية قلق أقرب حلفائها، وتخرج خطة الإنقاذ التي ينفذها "بيتر" و"إيزابيل" عن السيطرة بعد تدخل "الأب" الذي يثير المزيد من الفوضى.

7.o: يجد مستشار قانوني أمريكي في "المكسيك" نفسه عالقًا في مأزق عصيب. وبعد مُضيّ سنوات، يسقط في فخّ آخر... ليكون "بيتر" أمله الوحيد.

8.o: ثمة خصم غامض يدفع "بيتر" إلى أقصى حدود تحمّله في لعبة عقلية قاسية، ويستخدم "جايكوب" قاعدة بياناته الواسعة من الأسرار كورقة للمساومة.

9.o: يتأنى الرئيس في دراسة خياراته بينما يضغط أعضاء الحكومة لاتخاذ رد انتقامي سريع، وتسابق "إيزابيل" و"جاي" الزمن لفك شفرة "جايكوب". أما "بيتر"، فينتهي يومه وسط مواد متفجرة.

4.o: Frustrated by the rift between Olivia and his family, Ethan hopes time can heal their unresolved issues; Barry gets personal with Micah about the divorce; Moriah embraces her fresh start and her inner rebel.

5.o: Barry and Kim sit down with the kids to speak about more changes in the family. Moriah showcases her personal rebellion in the form of a tattoo. Ethan and Olivia say goodbye to Tampa while Moriah hosts her sisters for a special girls weekend.

6.o: Ethan and Olivia have settled into their new town in Minnesota and express high hopes for their marriage. Micah questions his future in Los Angeles. Kim tells her friend about a major update in her love life, but she fears telling her own children.

7.o: Olivia and Ethan host Lydia Grace and her boyfriend for Christmas. Kim hesitantly sits down with Isaac, hoping he'll approve of her dating his flight instructor. Micah and Moriah struggle to reconcile with Ethan. Oliva and Ethan's marital tension resurfaces.

8.t: Now Is The Winter Of Our Discontent
8.o: Kim starts new family traditions with the kids for Christmas. Barry and Micah spend the holidays alone. Olivia and Ethan confide in Lydia Grace and CJ that their marriage may have differences they can't overcome.

9.t: So Foul And Fair A Day
9.o: Kim nervously shares her dating news with Moriah and Lydia. Moriah decides to unblock and text Ethan and is taken aback by his response. Olivia hits her breaking point when she realizes Ethan is up to his old ways.

10.t: I Am Not Bound To Please...
10.o: Ethan leaves Olivia behind in Minnesota as he heads to Cairo to pick up his cars and reconnect with his family. Olivia talks to her friend about her marital issues and her struggle to stay true to her vows. Kim comes clean to Amber about Ken.

11.t: The Wheel Is Come Full Circle
11.o: Kim and Barry are together for the first time since the family learned of Kim dating Ken. Moriah attempts to break the ice and reaches out to Ethan during his road trip. Olivia extends an olive branch to Micah, hoping he's willing to meet with her on her terms.

12.o: Olivia and Ethan realize their marriage has reached an impasse due to differences in their values. Kim and Barry find it difficult to peacefully co-parent. Barry and Isaac visit Micah in LA and hope Ethan will join them despite his troubled marriage.

13.o: The Plath men go surfing in LA, and Barry and Ethan have a heart-to-heart. Olivia takes a trip to get some clarity on her marriage. Moriah crashes boys' weekend and comes face to face with Ethan for the first time in nearly a year. Ken pops an unexpected question to Kim.

14.t: To Be Or Not To Be...
14.o: Ethan and Moriah's feud comes to a head as they hash out past disagreements. Kim moves the remainder of her things out of the family home. Ethan and Olivia have an honest conversation about the future of their relationship.

1.o: Life in Plathville is looking very different these days. Moriah leaves Tampa behind. Kim throws caution to the wind and fulfills a lifelong dream and Micah walks away from his busy life in LA when a mysterious girl steals his heart.

2.o: Ethan and Olivia remain at odds over the future of their marriage, Kim ponders her next steps with Ken, and Ethan visits Cairo and reveals big news to his family. A visit to a tarot card reader leaves Olivia reeling and questioning her future.

3.o: The Plath men bond over their muscles at the gym, Olivia takes a huge leap and steps into the single scene with her sister, and Ethan decides it's time to break the ice and visit his mom.

4.t: You're Like a Stranger to Me Now
4.o: Ethan and Moriah bond over drinks. Kim gives Micah some relationship advice. Olivia drives to Minnesota hoping to finalize the divorce but detours when Moriah asks her to meet up to hash things out.

5.o: Olivia returns to Minnesota to finalize the divorce but Ethan struggles to accept the end of their marriage. The Plaths navigate their new blended family with Kim's boyfriend. Micah contemplates settling down with his girlfriend and Moriah enlists Kim's help with making a music video.

6.o: The Plath family comes together to run the Spartan Race but things get muddy when their family bonding event turns competitive; Olivia and Ethan take time to rediscover themselves; Micah's mystery girlfriend leaves everyone stunned.

7.o: Kim and Barry deal with the frustration of a drawn-out divorce. Back in LA, Olivia shares with her friend where things went wrong with Ethan and what she's looking for in her next relationship. Ethan and Micah return to Cairo to help throw a surprise birthday party for Lydia.

8.t: Wine Helps The Sex Ed Go Down
8.o: While Micah and his girlfriend embrace their future together, Ethan returns to the farm and gets real about some of the ways he and Olivia went wrong. Moriah talks music and heartbreak with her bestie and Olivia and Lydia Grace rebel against their roots and host a sex party!

9.o: The entire Plath family joins Moriah in Tampa to prep for her music video shoot but concerns grow over Kim and Barry being able to sleep under one roof. Olivia and Lydia Grace try their luck at speed dating, but no one measures up to a certain someone Olivia already has her eye on.

10.t: I Love You. I Love You.
10.o: Olivia and her long-distance boyfriend rendezvous in Arizona for a romantic getaway. It's lights, camera, action for the Plaths as they help Moriah shoot a music video for her new album. As Veronica gets to know Kim, she quickly learns its Kim's way or the highway.

11.t: I Grew Up Under A Rock
11.o: When Ethan's friend takes him out to a bar to meet girls for the first time ever, its sink or swim when a girl catches his eye. Veronica lets it be known to Micah she's ready for next steps. Olivia brings Lydia Grace and Brendan together, hoping they'll form a bond but Lydia Grace has her concerns.

12.o: The Plaths arrive in St. Pete for their long-awaited family band concert but things quickly go awry when Moriah reveals news that no one saw coming. Barry is finally confronted with Ken and must choose to talk or walk. Olivia finally decides to put down roots.
